source: Sgr OB1 association membership; maintainer-supplied. Gaia DR3 has photometry but no parallax for this star (G=3.76), and Hipparcos gives 0.09 +/- 0.28 mas -- smaller than its own error -- so no astrometric distance exists. A bibcode would be better than this note.

AT-HYG 4.0 gives this Cepheus star the Gaia DR3 source_id 647372483426742912, which belongs to tyc 1966-277-1 in Leo, 95.3 degrees away. Verified from the source_id itself: Gaia ids encode a level-12 HEALPix pixel, and this one decodes to RA 9.84814h Dec +28.3445 -- 0.0052 deg from the Leo star and 95.2869 deg from this one. The error is upstream in athyg_40.csv, not in this project's pipeline; both rows arrive carrying it. The bad id also brought the Leo star's distance (102.2432 pc), proper motion (-154.41, -40.68) and radial velocity, so every derived value is retracted with it. No correct parallax exists for this star, so it keeps only what was measured for it: its Tycho-2 position and magnitude.
